name: @hotelclaw/brain
description: Shared gbrain surface: MCP transport (OAuth client_credentials + SSE-aware tools/call), the disciplined capture shape, at-rest secret crypto, the curated tool descriptions/schemas (search/think/capture/get/list), the knowledge-discipline instruction text, and document->brain sync helpers. Keep it dependency-free apart from zod (node builtins allowed); NO react, NO server-only.
